# Test Data Directory

This directory contains test data files used in automated tests:

## File Upload Test Data

- **test-image.jpg** - Sample employee profile picture
- **profile.jpg** - Sample user profile picture  
- **resume.pdf** - Sample candidate resume

## Note

Replace these placeholder files with actual test files before running the tests that require file uploads.

Alternatively, you can create empty files with these names and the tests will still execute (though file upload verification may not be fully functional without actual content).
